description: Freeze refactor scope to fuzz/, bin/, and crates/{node,primitives,index,mempool,p2p,utxo,rpc}; record the 18-open-PR rebase cost in writing before any execution.
Gate all execution on green main CI (run 33769280615 verdict) plus explicit human approval of this plan; no worker starts before both.
Run read-only no-hide surveys on each target crate; deliver per-crate concealment reports with severity before any edit.
Run architect brownfield surveys; rank deepening candidates per crate and select one candidate with rationale; tasty-abstraction specs for any new boundary (design only, no code).
Publish per-crate coverage risk maps (llvm-cov diagnostic); add only oracle-bearing tests; keep public APIs stable unless a tasty spec justifies change.
Record domain terms in CONTEXT.md and decisions in the run report as the work lands; keep docs/rpc-reference style generated artifacts regenerated by their own tooling.
Execute per-crate discipline/style/test slices as diamond-task DAGs with disjoint write sets, checkpoint, and fresh-reviewer approval; verify each slice with fmt, clippy, test, deny.
Cut only clean-clean-cut enumerated VCS-tracked sets, each with its own purge checklist and exact-set human approval; never bundle deletions with behavior changes.
Gate each diamond slice run on green main CI plus its per-slice enumerated approval; no slice starts on red or on blanket approval.
Produce per-slice tasty/first-principle specs and diamond inputs (write sets, checks, checkpoint, reviewer) before any worker starts.
Run each approved slice as an isolated diamond DAG: validate diffs in-set, union mechanically, fresh-reviewer approval, verify gates, land atomically.
